description: Creates a draft invoice for a customer. Number, language, texts and VAT treatment come from the account settings. The invoice is not sent; it counts towards the monthly invoice maximum of the plan.

closing_text.description: Text below the items, defaults to the account's text

external_id.description: Identifier of the invoice in another system; a second invoice with the same one is refused

price.description: Price per unit, net or gross as set in the account (see prices_include_tax of an invoice)

tax_rate.description: VAT rate in percent; defaults to the account's default tax

unit_code.description: UN/ECE unit code such as C62 (piece) or HUR (hour)

opening_text.description: Text above the items, defaults to the account's text

name: create_invoice
title: Create a draft invoice
